kind: named checkpoint source for H9 — the stage18/19 k-ladder bases on machine A (an INDEX of weights, not the weights)
why_this_file_exists: Sitting 003 R2 conditions MEF's participation in H9 on a **named checkpoint source**. The bytes are git-ignored everywhere (law 1: large binaries are reconstructed, not committed — MEF/.gitignore line 17 `outputs/*/ckpt_k*.pt`, with the rationale 'reproducible from seed 13 + scripts/stage18_kairos_mini.py'), so 'named' cannot mean 'committed': it means (path, sha256, bytes, host, seed, recipe) recorded somewhere the fleet can read and re-verify. That is this file. 1 KB, no weights.
